set.body:
Outcome: decide whether a segment-Voronoi backend offers enough stability and correspondence benefit to justify a separate implementation effort.

Timebox: at most four hours of implementation/experiment time after preflight; record actual time and stop with a go/no-go/inconclusive report. This is a research cap, not an estimate or authorization for an unattended run. A production backend or default change is outside scope.

First gate: verify current Boost.Polygon/BH and CGAL component licenses, dependency versions, availability, package-license fit, and build burden. Baseline package declares GPL (>=3); that alone does not decide every dependency detail. Prior inspection found a Boost Voronoi header in installed BH 1.90.0.1, but verify rather than assume it still exists. Prototype Boost first; do not add CGAL or a permanent package dependency without the gate's justification.

Algorithmic constraints: Boost input coordinates are integral and segments may intersect only at shared endpoints. Define quantization scale and error budget, bounds/overflow handling, intersection splitting and overlap policy, and checks for topology changes during quantization. Preserve source-segment ownership. Explicitly define the finite domain and medial-edge selection for open line drawings; a raw Voronoi diagram is not already the current AOF MAT.

Acceptance: run a small fixed set of analytical and perturbation fixtures; compare geometry/correspondence stability, retained narrow structures, runtime, peak memory, and clean compilation cost with the existing raster path under stated method differences. Record build/portability results separately from unexecuted CRAN/platform claims. Stop early if license/build/topology constraints defeat the intended benefit. Retain a reproducible report with limitations and the decision for a future ticket; do not claim parity or production readiness.

Primary references to refresh: https://www.boost.org/doc/libs/latest/libs/polygon/doc/voronoi_main.htm ; https://www.boost.org/LICENSE_1_0.txt ; https://doc.cgal.org/latest/Segment_Delaunay_graph_2/group__PkgSegmentDelaunayGraph2Ref.html
set.title: Timebox a Boost segment-Voronoi feasibility and build-cost prototype
